overall: Tomorrow (Friday, June 26) in Los Angeles will be a mild, marine-influenced day with patchy fog clearing before 11am, followed by partly sunny skies. Best estimate for tomorrow's high is 72°F, consistent with the ensemble mean, prior-day observation (72.0°F), and the consensus of ECMWF/HRRR/NBM/Weather.com, but confidence is low.
